name: Grok
description: Grok's home on every New Tab: a greeting, one prompt box that starts a Grok chat, a few suggestions and your recent Grok chats.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats, to list your recent Grok chats.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a chat's workspace when you click it.
scopes.actions:run: Start a Grok chat from the prompt box, or open a chat in a tab.
